description: Use this when a Phorme member wants their own coach, the one running their plan in the Phorme app, for example "tell my coach I only have 30 minutes today", "move tomorrow's run to Friday", "log my squats, 4 sets of 5 at 225" or "what's my plan this week". It sends their words to that coach, which answers from their real plan and log and can change the plan the way it does in the app chat; on food, Nutmeg answers. It returns the coach's words, every change it made and any question it asked. Send the member's own words. Every change shows in the Phorme app with Undo. It needs a connected Phorme account with the training:write permission. Do not use it for coaches testing their own brain (ask_my_coach) or for medical emergencies.

message.description: What the member says to their coach, in their own words.

name: talk_to_my_coach

changes.description: Each change the coach made or could not make: change, status (applied or refused) and reason.

coach.description: Which Phorme coach spoke, for example nutmeg on food.

question.description: A question the coach asked, with options. Ask the member and send their answer back with this tool.

reply.description: The coach's words. Show them as the coach's own.

title: Talk to my Phorme coach
